rv.q: Tom Holland and Francesca Amewudah-Rivers are tremulously intense lovers in Jamie Lloyd’s stark, dark take on Shakespeare’s tragedy
It turns out that, aside from some harmless frippery on the edges of the production, this is a remarkably strong Romeo + Juliet, performed in the round at Circle in the Square.
Although the production has a heartbeat, it's missing a heart.
Gold engages in thoughtful and amusing double casting.

cn.t: A sleek, well-acted production with thoughtful casting choices and strong staging, but critics find it emotionally hollow where it matters most, failing to generate the heartbreak essential to Shakespeare's tragedy.
